accepted.sentence: On a computer assembly bench, a small hand tool is kept nearby for securing case panels and internal brackets.
In an eyeglass repair shop, a precision-sized version helps tighten tiny screws in hinges and frame joints.
When replacing a child's toy batteries, a household kit may include one for opening the compartment's small fastened cover.
Cabinet installers carry one to attach drawer slides and hinges where factory-drilled mounting holes meet threaded hardware.
A musical-instrument repair bench may keep one ready for adjusting cover plates and other screw-fastened fittings.
In automotive trim work, technicians remove small fasteners securing interior panels before inspecting clips and wiring.
During plumbing fixture installation, one can secure handles or trim plates after the underlying valve assembly is mounted.
At a stage set, crew members use one to secure hinges on lightweight scenery panels before a scene change.
